---
title: Prepare boundary data
---

# Objective
+ In this script, I will prepare datasets that will be used throughout the project. These datasets include: 
  + Boundary data for the 235 global river basins (e.g., basin boundary, country-basin correspondence, etc.)



# Global Major River Basins (235 basins)
+ Get the GCAM 235-basin boundary data is downloaded from JGCRI Github repository for `gcammaptools` R package. The data is stored in `Raw/Boundary/gcam_235_basins.gpkg`.


```{r}
# --- Download the GCAM 235-basin boundary object --- #
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".rda")

download.file(
  url = "https://github.com/JGCRI/gcammaptools/raw/master/data/map.basin235.rda",
  destfile = tmp,
  mode = "wb"
)

# --- load the downloaded file --- #
load(tmp)

# --- correct crs --- #
map.basin235 <- st_set_crs(map.basin235, NA)
map.basin235 <- st_set_crs(map.basin235, 4326)

# --- Save --- #
st_write(
  map.basin235,
  here("Data/raw/Boundary/gcam_235_basins.gpkg"),
  delete_dsn = TRUE
)
```
